description.paragraph-1: API (Application Programming Interface) is a set of commands, functions, and protocols that can be used by programmers when building software, thus creating a stable and fast interconnection between systems.
description.paragraph-2: This API is the path that partners and hosts can use to interact between programs. The API can be used to make requests such as checking account balance, checking service prices, checking transaction status, and creating new transactions.
description.paragraph-3: API connection requires basic knowledge of computer programming. If you do not understand the documentation we provide, please contact us.
description.paragraph-4: Here are a few things to consider for API connection:
description.bullet-1: We wrap all HTTP Responses in JSON format.
description.bullet-2: All HTTP Requests are sent as POST Requests.
description.bullet-3: Please Whitelist your IP in your account settings.
